identity.description: Who owns the work. Used for the marks and the EXIF ownership tags.

copyrightNotice.description: Written to EXIF Copyright. {year} is substituted at build time.

seed.description: Changing this reshuffles every mark position. Keep it stable once live, or all outputs change and caches bust.

query.description: Override the GROQ query used to list assets.

mapFile.description: Where to write the key→files lookup the site renders from.

publicBase.description: URL prefix for the outputs. Inferred from dir when omitted.

widths.description: Long-edge sizes to emit. Never upscaled past the source.

veil.description: The tiled pattern layer: strongest at the frame edge, fading through the centre.

sizeRatio.description: Font size as a fraction of the long edge.

gapRatio.description: Horizontal gap between repeats, as a multiple of text width.

color.description: A hex colour, or "auto" to flip to dark ink on bright images.

darkOpacityScale.description: Dark ink reads stronger per unit opacity; this trims it back.

blend.description: Any libvips blend mode. 'over' is literal; 'soft-light' is subtler.

falloff.description: Vignette curve exponent. Higher keeps the centre clean for longer.

marks.description: The covert edge signatures, placed adaptively per image.

minPx.description: Floor so marks stay legible on the smallest variant.

contrastDelta.description: Luminance distance from the local background, 0–1.

followEdge.description: Rotate marks to run along left/right edges.
